title: SM ST1C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST1C 静态励磁系统，带自动电压调节器，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} 调节器增益、{Regulator output time constant, T_A (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} 指定第一个超前-滞后环节的调节器滞后时间常数、{Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} 指定第一个超前-滞后环节的调节器超前时间常数、{Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B 1(s)} 指定第二个超前-滞后环节的调节器滞后时间常数、{Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C1 (s)} 指定第二个超前-滞后环节的调节器超前时间常数、{Rate feedback gain, K_F (pu)} 指定速率反馈增益、{Rate feedback time constant, T_F (s)} 指定速率反馈时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Amax (pu)} 调节器输出上限、{Minimum regulator output, V_Amin (pu)} 调节器输出下限、{Maximum voltage error (regulator input), V_Imax (pu)} 指定电压上限、{Minimum voltage error (regulator input), V_Imin (pu)} 指定电压下限、{Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} 指定 PSS 输入位置 Summation point at voltage、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Exciter output current limiter gain, K_LR (pu)} 指定励磁机输出电流限制器增益、{Exciter output current limit reference, I_LR (pu)} 指定励磁机输出电流限制参考值、{Maximum exciter output, V_Rmax (pu)} 指定励磁机上限、{Minimum exciter output, V_Rmin (pu)} 指定励磁机下限，按实例取值。
